title: Attorney General of Florida
organization: Office of the Attorney General, State of Florida
uf_degree: Undergraduate degree, University of Florida (Wikipedia additionally cites a BS and MA from UF; exact major not specified in official bio)
source_note: Official Florida Attorney General biography page, states he 'graduated from the University of Florida'
notes: JD is from Georgetown University Law Center (2014); UF connection is his undergraduate education. Sworn in as Florida's 39th Attorney General in February 2025, succeeding Ashley Moody (also a UF Law alumna) who resigned to become a U.S. Senator.

title: Justice (former Chief Justice)
uf_degree: BA Political Science (1976) and JD (1979), University of Florida
source_note: Florida Bar Journal profile confirming both UF undergraduate and JD degrees
notes: Took office on the Florida Supreme Court in January 2009; served as Chief Justice 2014-2016. Confirmed still an active sitting justice as of 2026 (mandatory retirement not until October 2027, when he turns 75). Contact info is the court Clerk's Office, not a personal chambers line.

title: Justice
uf_degree: BA Political Science (with honors), University of Florida, 1993
source_note: The Florida Bar News article on his appointment/investiture, confirming UF undergraduate degree
notes: JD is from Georgetown University Law Center (1996). Appointed to the Florida Supreme Court by Gov. DeSantis, took office January 15, 2026, succeeding Charles Canady. Previously served on the First District Court of Appeal (2019-2026) and as General Counsel for the Florida House of Representatives (2016-2019).

title: Justice
uf_degree: BA, University of Florida (2005); JD, University of Florida Levin College of Law (2008)
source_note: Official Florida Supreme Court biography page
notes: Appointed by Gov. DeSantis, took office May 2023. Prior roles include Chief Deputy General Counsel to Gov. Rick Scott, Judge on the Fifth District Court of Appeal, and inaugural Chief Judge of the Sixth District Court of Appeal. Both her bachelor's and law degrees are from UF.

title: Chief Judge
organization: United States District Court for the Northern District of Florida
uf_degree: JD, University of Florida Fredric G. Levin College of Law, 2002
notes: Became Chief Judge of the Northern District of Florida on June 23, 2025. Previously Solicitor General of Florida (2013-2016), judge on the Florida First District Court of Appeal (2016-2019), and U.S. District Judge since 2019. Contact info is the Clerk's Office, not a personal chambers line.

title: Chief Judge
organization: United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida
uf_degree: JD (with honors), University of Florida Fredric G. Levin College of Law, 1990
notes: Became Chief Judge of the Middle District of Florida on November 3, 2024. Elected to the Order of the Coif at UF Law; served as Symposium Editor of the Florida Law Review. Contact info is the Clerk's Office (Jacksonville division), not a personal chambers line.

title: Circuit Judge
organization: United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit
uf_degree: BA, University of Florida (2000); JD magna cum laude, University of Florida Fredric G. Levin College of Law (2004)
notes: Appointed by President Trump, took office on the Eleventh Circuit Nov. 19, 2019. Previously a Justice of the Florida Supreme Court (2019) and judge on the Florida Third District Court of Appeal and Eleventh Judicial Circuit. Order of the Coif at UF Law. Contact info is the Clerk's Office in Atlanta (court-wide), not a personal chambers line -- he sits in the Miami division.

title: United States Magistrate Judge
organization: United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida
uf_degree: BA, University of Florida (1993); JD, University of Florida Levin College of Law (1996)
source_note: Official U.S. Courts (uscourts.gov) judicial milestones biography, confirming both UF degrees; also named a 2025 UF Law Alumni Award recipient
notes: Appointed U.S. Magistrate Judge for the Middle District of Florida in 2013; reappointed for a subsequent term. Previously an Assistant U.S. Attorney (MDFL) and clerked for Eleventh Circuit Judge Emmett Cox. Recognized with a 2025 UF Levin College of Law Alumni Award. Magistrate judge is a slightly less senior federal judicial role than a district or circuit judgeship, included here for the strength/clarity of her UF sourcing.
